# Shivam Thakur — Full Stack Developer

> applications end to end with React, Next.js and Node.js. This site is his portfolio:
> case studies of shipped products, the services he offers, and practical articles on
> modern web development. The whole site is static HTML with clean, extensionless URLs.

## Case Studies

- [Case Studies overview](https://shivamthakur.me/case-studies): index of selected projects with problem, solution and results.
- [MyDigiSense](https://shivamthakur.me/case-studies/mydigisense-digital-presence-marketplace-platform): a SaaS platform for digital presence and a services marketplace — website, listings and bookings in one place. Built with Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL and MongoDB. Live at https://mydigisence.com
- [ProDigiChat](https://shivamthakur.me/case-studies/prodigichat-whatsapp-marketing-automation-platform): a SaaS WhatsApp marketing and automation tool — broadcast campaigns, chatbot flows and a shared team inbox on the WhatsApp Cloud API. Built with React, Node.js, Redis and WebSockets. Live at https://prodigichat.com
- [DigiCRM](https://shivamthakur.me/case-studies/digicrm-invoice-payment-management-crm): a CRM portal for invoice and payment management — automated invoice generation and PDFs, scheduled email payment reminders, payment tracking and client management. Built with Next.js, Node.js and PostgreSQL.

## Services

- [Services overview](https://shivamthakur.me/services): full list of what Shivam offers.
- [Web Development](https://shivamthakur.me/services/web-development): full-stack web apps built end to end with React, Next.js and Node.js.
- [Web Design](https://shivamthakur.me/services/web-design): modern, responsive UI/UX and design systems.
- [API & Backend Development](https://shivamthakur.me/services/api-backend-development): REST and GraphQL APIs, auth, data modelling, scalable Node.js architecture.
- [Frontend Development](https://shivamthakur.me/services/frontend-development): pixel-accurate, accessible, high-performance React interfaces.
- [Performance & SEO](https://shivamthakur.me/services/performance-seo): Core Web Vitals, technical SEO, structured data, and AEO/GEO signals.
- [Custom Software Development](https://shivamthakur.me/services/custom-software-development): inventory, POS, HRMS, billing and operations software; Excel-to-app conversion and legacy modernization.
- [CRM & ERP Development](https://shivamthakur.me/services/crm-erp-development): lead pipelines, quotations, invoicing, GST billing, payments and stock modules.
- [SaaS Product Development](https://shivamthakur.me/services/saas-product-development): MVP builds, multi-tenant architecture, subscription billing and admin tooling.
- [Mobile App Development](https://shivamthakur.me/services/mobile-app-development): React Native and Flutter apps for Android and iOS, plus Progressive Web Apps and store submission.
- [Ecommerce Development](https://shivamthakur.me/services/ecommerce-development): WooCommerce, Shopify and custom stores with Razorpay/PhonePe payments, shipping and GST invoicing.
- [WhatsApp Business API Development](https://shivamthakur.me/services/whatsapp-business-api-development): Cloud API onboarding, chatbots, template approval, broadcasts, shared inbox and CRM integration.
- [Meta API Integration](https://shivamthakur.me/services/meta-api-integration): Lead Ads to CRM sync, Conversions API server-side tracking, Marketing API automation and Instagram tooling.
- [Cloud & DevOps Services](https://shivamthakur.me/services/cloud-devops-services): AWS/GCP/VPS setup, CI/CD, Docker, monitoring, automated backups, security hardening and cost optimization.
- [Website Maintenance & Support](https://shivamthakur.me/services/website-maintenance-support): monthly retainers covering updates, backups, uptime monitoring, security patching and content changes.
